commands.summary: Read a project file: its designs, board, central library and library lists.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

commands.summary: Create a project: in a Designer session from a setup template, with its own copy of the central library and a board design (a long job); in file mode by copying the project given with --doc.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: The new project's .prj file; its folder must not exist or must be empty, and its path must be ASCII.

flags.name: --template
flags.summary: In a Designer session: the setup template; Xpedition's stock template (expedition/Default.prj) by default.

commands.summary: List the parts of the project's central library.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --limit
flags.summary: Items per page; 50 by default, at most 500.

flags.name: --offset
flags.summary: Start position of the page.

commands.summary: Read one part: its pin map, symbols, footprint cell, padstacks and the problems found.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --id
flags.summary: The part number.

commands.summary: Add parts to the central library from a parts file: symbol, IPC-7351B footprint, padstacks and pin map.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --file
flags.summary: The parts file (JSON). A part identical to the library's is skipped; a part number the library holds with other content is refused.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Draw the whole schematic from a design file, replacing every sheet it names; runs as a long job.

commands.summary: Create the project's board from a layout template with Xpedition's JobWizard.

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --template
flags.summary: The layout template's name; 4 Layer Template by default.

flags.name: --name
flags.summary: The board's name: letters, digits, - and _; the project's name by default.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Replace the board outline by a rectangle from the origin; the route border and manufacturing outline follow.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --width
flags.summary: The board's width.

flags.name: --height
flags.summary: The board's height.

flags.name: --radius
flags.summary: The corner radius; 0 for square corners.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Place every component of the board from its connections, grouped by schematic sheet.

flags.name: --session
flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --design
flags.summary: The design file the schematic was drawn from; its sheets and zones group the parts.

flags.name: --all
flags.summary: Place the parts already placed again too.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.

commands.summary: Pour a plane shape for one net on one layer, inside the board outline.

flags.summary: The session ID of the instance (DCLI-202).

flags.name: --doc
flags.summary: The document: its ID or path; in file mode, the file path.

flags.name: --net
flags.summary: The net, such as GND.

flags.name: --layer
flags.summary: The conductor layer number, 1 at the top.

flags.name: --margin
flags.summary: The distance from the board outline; 1 mm by default.

flags.name: --output
flags.summary: Write the full preview, with every change, to this file.
